content.title: Is Publix open today on Easter Sunday? What to know before you go
content.text: April 5, 2026, 6:03 a.m. ETEaster is one of only three holidays Publix closes for, along with Thanksgiving and Christmas.Several other grocery stores, including Walmart and Whole Foods, will be open on Easter.Shoppers should verify the hours of their local stores as some may have reduced holiday hours.It's Easter Sunday and hopefully, you have already completed your holiday grocery shopping beforehand.But did you realize you forgot a chocolate bunny for a basket, a hostess gift for Easter brunch, or an ingredient for your deviled eggs today?Many Floridians opt for their beloved Publix for regular grocery shopping, but is it open on Easter Sunday today? Here's what to know before you leave your home.When is Easter 2026?Easter Sunday is today, April 5. Eastern Orthodox Easter will fall on Sunday, April 12, 2026.The holiday's date is determined by the moon and is celebrated on the Sunday after the first full moon after the spring equinox, according to Christianity.com.Will Publix be open on Easter holiday 2026?No. Publix locations in Florida and other states will not be open on Easter Sunday, which is Sunday, April 5.Of all the holidays throughout the year, Publix stores are closed only three days: Thanksgiving, Christmas, and Easter. Will Publix liquor stores or pharmacies be open?No, Publix liquor stores and pharmacies will also be closed.What grocery stores are open on Easter Sunday 2026?While many stores close for Easter Sunday each year, a few will remain open across Florida:Whole FoodsSproutsWinn-DixieTrader Joe'sBJ's WholesaleWalmartShop with Walmart+ membershipNote that some of these retailers may have reduced hours at all or some of their locations due to the holiday. Check your nearest location's hours before you head to the store.Samantha Neely is a trending reporter for the USA TODAY NETWORK-Florida, covering pop culture, theme parks, breaking news and more.
